Name: Grandpa's Tools Unofficial
Author: SrEthryan
Description:
[b]
[/b][center][b][size=5]This is an unofficial update to Grandpa's Tools.[/size][/b]
This Unofficial update is aimed at fixing the renaming feature of the original mod.
And a tentative fix for Prismatic Tools Continued to work without manual editing.


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8835]Link to Original Mod[/url]﻿

Original Descrition:[s]
[s]                                                                                                                                          [/s]

[/s][color=red][size=4]I Upload my mods ONLY on Nexusmods.com  Do NOT reupload them elsewhere without permission.[/size][/color][s]

                                                                                                                                                                              [/s]

This mod changes textures of tools ( see images for the whole list ) and some names. 
Now the tools will look crappy at the start and with each upgrade they will get slightly better.
Retextures and renaming can be disabled in config.json

[s]                                                                                                                                                                             [/s]
[size=5][u]
[b]Installation:[/b][/u][/size]

[color=red]SMAPI, Content Patcher nedeed![/color]
1. Download 
2. Unzip/extract
3. Paste into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

[size=1]Optional:[/size]
4. Run the game once to generate config.json
5. Edit config.json to your liking
